about_the_game:
About the Game:

Full Motion Voyeur is a cinematic FMV horror‑thriller that blends immersive storytelling with real‑time surveillance. You are Claire, trapped in the Darkest Room and compelled to feed Sinners to a ravenous Demon. By scanning live security cameras, webcams, and phone sensors, you track down victims for the Demon to devour at your command. Each victim helps the Demon grow, while your fate—and your family’s—hangs in the balance.

As you Investigate video streams and clues deeper questions surface: Who are these people you’re watching and destroying? Who granted you this power and why? What happens if you disobey? Your decisions matter, and the consequences of your actions are irreversible.

The non‑linear campaign weaves filmed sequences, branching quests, and side missions that blur cinema and interactive play. Face tough moral choices and slowly unravel the twisted machinery behind your role.

Wishlist on Steam and learn the price of feeding the Demon.

Gameplay Features:

  • Tense Atmosphere Where Choices Matter: Immerse yourself in a dark world where visual storytelling meets tense, high-stakes decision-making. Who you choose to spare or feed to the Demon directly influences the outcome of the story.

  • Moral Ambiguity: Full Motion Voyeur mixes Her Story style investigative gameplay with Papers, Please like gameplay. In Full Motion Voyeur you can choose to blindly follow the Demon’s instructions or risk facing the consequences.

  • Deep World: Investigate various video feeds and explore interconnected storylines. Discover how seemingly unrelated events are all part of a greater puzzle, while you try to escape The Darkest Room.

  • Replayability: Multiple playthroughs offer new discoveries, outcomes, and moral dilemmas. How far will you go to feed the Demon?

Why Play Full Motion Voyeur?

If you’re a fan of narrative-driven games Her Story and Papers, Please, Full Motion Voyeur offers a gripping horror experience with gameplay where your actions matter. Full Motion Voyeur is perfect for players who love FMV games with complex storytelling, dark psychological thrillers, and unique gameplay mechanics that challenge traditional FMV conventions.

Spread the word and Wishlist now!

content_descriptors.notes:
Full Motion Voyeur contains mature content not suitable for all audiences. The game includes depictions of violence, death, and morally complex decisions involving life-or-death outcomes. It also features veiled sexual situations, the use of drugs and alcohol, and frequent strong language. While no explicit sexual acts are shown, adult themes and emotionally intense scenes are part of the narrative.

Player discretion is advised, especially for those sensitive to themes of surveillance, manipulation, and psychological distress.

  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card or equivalent

short_description: Full Motion Voyeur is a dark FMV thriller with brutal gameplay: investigate video feeds, judge sinners, and feed them to a hungry Demon. Uncover buried secrets, grapple with moral choices, and decide if obeying the Demon to protect your loved ones is worth it. How far will you go to feed the Demon?
